characters.name: Moshe
characters.description: Very old man of about 120, slender and slightly stooped, long flowing white beard and white hair, kind tired brown eyes, warm olive skin, simple light cream linen robe with a sand-colored sash, plain undyed head cloth, sandals, holds a tall plain wooden shepherd's staff. No glow or rays around his head.

characters.name: Itai
characters.description: Present-day boy about 6, energetic, light olive skin, short curly dark-brown hair, big brown eyes, gap-toothed grin, white knitted kippah, white holiday shirt and navy trousers; signature item: a small blue-and-white paper holiday flag on a stick with no writing.

characters.name: Abba
characters.description: Itai's father in the present day, about 38, tall, light olive skin, short black beard, smiling brown eyes, black knitted kippah, white tallit with black stripes over a white shirt and dark trousers.

cover.prompt: A two-part picture joined by a soft golden glow: on the left, old Moshe seen from behind standing on a mountaintop at sunset, looking out over a green land; on the right, in a warm present-day synagogue of Jerusalem stone, Itai rides on Abba's shoulders waving his flag as people dance in a circle holding closed Torah scrolls in decorated velvet covers. Warm, joyful, a feeling of endings and beginnings.

pages.prompt: Old Moshe stands on a low rise in the desert camp at morning, arms gently open, gathering the whole people around him. Families come from the tents, children running ahead, elders walking slowly. Moshe's face is tender and a little sad, but full of love. Wide shot, soft golden light.

Moshe walks slowly among the tribes, stopping before each group with his hand raised in blessing over a bowed head, like a loving grandfather giving each grandchild a different gift. Each tribe stands beside its own colored banner with simple symbols and no writing. Warm afternoon light, medium-wide shot.

Three moments of blessing in a gentle triptych: Moshe blesses a strong man of Judah with a lion-colored cloak; a man of Zebulun with a small wooden model ship as distant sailboats glide on a blue sea; and a man of Asher beside olive trees heavy with fruit and a jar of shining oil. Each face lit with joy. Bright, varied colors.

Moshe, seen from behind and small in the frame, climbs slowly step by step up a high rocky mountain path, leaning on his staff. Far below, the camp and the people watching him go. Wide vertical-feeling composition, late afternoon light, quiet and solemn.

From the top of Mount Nevo, seen from behind Moshe's shoulder: the whole land spread out below in a breathtaking panorama - green hills, golden fields, palm trees, and far away the shining blue sea. A soft warm light from the sky bathes the land as if it is being shown to him. Wide, luminous, sunset tones.

Moshe sits on a rock at the mountaintop, seen from behind and slightly to the side, gazing for a long time at the green land glowing in the sunset. His posture is peaceful, his staff resting beside him, a gentle smile visible in profile. Quiet, contemplative mood, warm golden-pink light.

The mountaintop of Nevo, now empty, bathed in soft gentle light from the evening sky, a quiet breeze moving the grass. Far below in the plains, the people sit together in small groups, weeping quietly and hugging, heads bowed, children leaning on their parents. Soft muted colors, tender sadness, no figure on the mountain.

A large closed Torah scroll with plain wooden handles, wrapped in a simple cloth, carried lovingly by families in the desert camp at dawn. Children gather close around it, touching it gently, faces hopeful. Warm sunrise light spreads from the horizon, a feeling that Moshe's gift remains.

A present-day synagogue of warm Jerusalem stone full of joy on Simchat Torah: men and boys in kippot dance in circles holding closed Torah scrolls in decorated velvet covers with silver crowns. Itai rides on Abba's shoulders waving his little flag, children toss candies, and women and girls clap and sing from the side. Bright festive lights, lively movement.

At the reading table, a Torah scroll lies open with its columns shown only as soft blurred lines, no letters visible, and the whole congregation stands together calling out, fists raised joyfully. Itai stands on a bench beside Abba, shouting along with a huge smile. Warm golden synagogue light, medium-wide shot.

Close view of two people at the reading table carefully rolling the large Torah scroll all the way back to its beginning, the wooden handles turning, the parchment showing only blurred columns. Itai watches with wide fascinated eyes, holding Abba's hand. A soft warm glow suggests a fresh start. Gentle, wondering mood.

Outside the synagogue at evening, Itai hugs Abba, both smiling and looking up at a sky where a soft sunset meets the first stars, like an ending that becomes a beginning. Itai holds his little flag against his heart. Warm golden-blue tones, peaceful, comforting, hopeful.
